name: Global Innovation Index
publisher: WIPO (with Cornell University and INSEAD in earlier editions)

govt_response.title: PIB: Economic Survey 2025-26 on GII rank improving to 38th in 2025 from 66th in 2019
govt_response.summary: Government cites the rise as evidence of strengthening innovation performance; India is first among lower-middle-income economies and in Central and Southern Asia.

govt_response.title: Lok Sabha reply describing GII 2017 result
govt_response.summary: Parliamentary answer describing the 2017 result as a 21-place improvement from 81st in 2015 and 6 places from 66th in 2016.

methodology_note:
WIPO states data availability and changes to the GII model framework influence year-on-year comparisons; the 2025 confidence interval for India's rank is 37-41 and for 2026 is 34-39. Out-of counts not confirmed (omitted) for 2013, 2015, 2017, 2018; sources conflict for 2017 (127 vs 130). 2013 (66) and 2014 (76, down ten) per press/secondary tables; 2018 WIPO brief says 57th, up three from 2017. WIPO country briefs 2019-2026 are primary sources. India's rise is real across the series but part of it reflects model changes.

Back-fill (pre-2014 editions, researched by deepseek, unreviewed): WIPO states data availability and changes to the GII model framework influence year-on-year comparisons; the 2025 confidence interval for India's rank is 37-41 and for 2026 is 34-39. Out-of counts not confirmed (omitted) for 2013, 2015, 2017, 2018; sources conflict for 2017 (127 vs 130). 2013 (66) and 2014 (76, down ten) per press/secondary tables; 2018 WIPO brief says 57th, up three from 2017. WIPO country briefs 2019-2026 are primary sources. India's rise is real across the series but part of it reflects model changes. Earlier editions added: the GII began in 2007 (India 23rd of 107, on a 1-7 score); the 2008-2009 edition (recorded here as 2009) ranked India 41st of 130; the 2009-2010 edition (recorded as 2010) ranked India 56th of 132; 2011: 62nd of 125; 2012: 64th of 141. The 2007-2010 editions used a 1-7 score and different indicator sets, and the GII was substantially revamped for 2011 (0-100 score, new framework) and again in later years, so ranks across the 2007-2013 period are only loosely comparable. No 2004-2006 edition exists. Values for 2007-2010 and 2012 are from INSEAD/WIPO rankings compiled by areppim (each table cites INSEAD-WIPO); 2011 is from SpicyIP's report of the 2011 GII.
